PC_SESSION_STATUS_VARIANCE 4/4 session_invalidation conditions with variance confirms graded session_status_check (401/403/500) creates variance while preserving session_change=1.

Power analysis VERIFIED: min_detectable |r| at n=480 =0.0895 (tanh(1.96/sqrt(477))), producer reports 0.0895 exact. Min n for |r|=0.05 =1538 (ceil 3+(1.96/0.05004)^2), producer reports 1538. Fisher assumptions (bivariate normality) disclosed as supplementary in prereg validity threats; permutation test is primary — consistent disclosure.

claim_ceiling: MAXIMUM JUSTIFIED: On deterministic Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT HS256 localhost mock with graded session_status_check (401->1.0, 403->0.5, 500->0.75, 200->0.0) and unauthenticated /schema structural probe, 8 co-occurring conditions (permission_boundary/session_invalidation x 4 structural noises), SEED=42, 60 samples/condition (n=480 pooled), behavioral and structural signals show near-zero correlation |r|=0.0335 (r2=0.001, Fisher z=0.0336, p=0.464, permutation p=0.465). TP/variance trade-off remains broken (mean TP=1.0 Wilson 0.94, 8/8 variance, FP=0.0). Orthogonality is PLAUSIBLE but NOT formally confirmed at preregistered p<0.05; the test is provably underpowered (min detectable |r|=0.0895 at n=480, min n=1538 for |r|=0.05, expected p=0.274). Outcome is correctly MIXED: frozen conjunctive gate fails, power analysis bounds the failure. Product: retain composite multi-signal classifiers as precautionary; do NOT promote to independent parallel channels. C-FRESHNESS remains EXPERIMENTAL. No inference to real APIs, production middleware (RS256/ES256/OAuth/OIDC), DB/cache/CDN stochasticity, or alternative mappings warranted without new experiment. Decision rule must be revised (equivalence/TOST or CI bound or n~1600) before confirmatory claim.
